Galician

[edit]

Verb

[edit]

priorizar (first-person singular present priorizo, first-person singular preterite prioricei, past participle priorizado)
priorizar (first-person singular present priorizo, first-person singular preterite priorizei, past participle priorizado, reintegrationist norm)

[edit]

From prior(idade) +‎ -izar.
